title: Adaptive refinement of a 3 mm post across WR-90, wall to wall, at 10 GHz: passes from 6 mm until ΔS < 1e-3
source: The full-height post is a two-dimensional problem: the parallel-plate Green's function in modes with its static part summed in closed form (Marcuvitz, Waveguide Handbook, 1951, §5.11; Lewin, Theory of Waveguides, 1975, ch. 6), the first-kind integral equation on the post solved by Kress's log-split Nyström method (Kress, Linear Integral Equations, 3rd ed., 2014, ch. 12–13), converged to 1e-11 at 32 nodes, evaluated at 128 (emcraft-theory::post, independent of the finite elements)

quantities.reason: the loop stops at ΔS < 1e-3 (pass 4, 287 116 unknowns, order 2: |S11 − reference| = 1.3e-4). What is left is the curved surface's geometry: S moves by 478 per metre of radius, so 1e-4 is the post 0.2 µm off, the quadratic edges' departure from the circle; uniform meshes stall there too (5.9e-5 at 3 mm, 1.1e-4 at 1 mm, 8.1e-5 at 0.8 mm)
as |S11|; |S21| = √(1 − |S11|²) moves three times as fast

quantities.quantity: ΔS of the last pass (largest change of any S entry)
